title: This is pretty decent.
text:
This is pretty decent.. Even though I gave it a three, I am not upset about anything in particular. It's a little on the small side. I can only put about a quarter cup of corn in there. When cooking in the microwave, you have to stop before all the kernels are popped, or it will burn. IDEK if that is due to the item or just the nature of microwaving popcorn.

It probably deserves a higher rating since it does exactly what it claims to do.
